_note: MOCK DATA - post goals (13 Nov 2026, owner's D1 + D2, the rest written by C4) and sample conversations for the Messaging section. Georgian texts machine-written, not proofread. Not real people.

goals.name: Sell
goals.description: I am posting several products that are in stock and selling well. The text should catch people's attention and make them buy. Short.
goals.template_ka: {product} — {price} ₾. პოპულარული არჩევანი, მარაგი შეზღუდულია. შეკვეთისთვის მოგვწერეთ!

goals.name: Stock replenishment
goals.description: Products that were out of stock or in high demand are available again. Tell customers the stock is here.

goals.name: New arrival
goals.description: A product we did not have before. Introduce it: what it is, who it is for, the price.

goals.name: Offer or discount
goals.description: A lower price or a special offer for a limited time. Say the price or the condition and until when it lasts.

goals.name: Season or holiday
goals.description: A post tied to a season or a holiday (winter, New Year, school, summer): which products fit and why now.
goals.template_ka: სეზონის რჩევა: {product} — {price} ₾. მოგვწერეთ და დაგეხმარებით არჩევაში.

goals.name: Advice and trust
goals.description: Useful advice or an explanation without pushing to buy. Builds trust in the brand; mention the product gently.
goals.template_ka: რჩევა: როგორ შევარჩიოთ {product}? მოგვწერეთ და ჩვენი სპეციალისტი დაგეხმარებათ.

messages.text: Hi! Do you organise guided valley walks this weekend?
Hello! Yes, Saturday at 10:00. How many people?
Two adults. What is the price?
Is the sunset table free tonight for two?
